Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Depression ISANG
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 22 August 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Bulacan, Metro Manila, Cavite, Quezon, Laguna, Rizal and Batangas within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Tarlac and Pampanga which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

GRABE ANG HALOS WALANG-GALAWANG TRAFFIC!

Nagmistulang parking lot ng mga sasakyan ang toll plaza ng South Luzon Expressway (SLEX) sa Villamor, Pasay ngayong Biyernes, Aug. 22.

Ayon sa monitoring ng SLEX-Manila Toll Expressway Systems, Inc. (SLEX-MaTES), umabot sa 1.5 kilometer ang mabigat na trapiko mula Sales Bridge sa Pasay hanggang Osmeña Highway sa Maynila.

Dulot daw ito ng sabayang paglabas ng mga truck mula Laguna patungong Pier South sa Maynila simula ala-1 ng hapon. Nagdulot din ng bottleneck ang U-turn slot sa EDSA–Osmeña Highway area kung saan dumaraan ang mga truck mula Cavite patungo rin sa Maynila. | via Gary De Leon
